AFWD.justification: The reaction proceeds toward the first gap closure through a directed electronic shift

AREV.justification: The chain undergoes conformational backtracking when encountering high-energy barriers

CLINK.justification: The sequential binding of the linker to the macrocycle backbone creates a continuous chain

ENGAGR.justification: The molecule exists in a superposition of bonded and non-bonded states during the reaction peak

EVALF.justification: The spatial orientation fails to meet the 0.85 probability requirement for closure

EVALT.justification: The electron density reaches the required threshold for stable covalent bonding

FFUSE.justification: The two divergent arms meet to reconstitute the single continuous molecular loop

FSPLIT.justification: The telechelic ends diverge to target the < and ∋ sites simultaneously

IFIX.justification: The irreversible sharing of electrons creates a permanent structural link

IMSCRIB.justification: The internal carbon-carbon framework remains unchanged throughout the cyclization process

TANCH.justification: The final stable ring structure defines the boundary of the completed reaction

VINIT.justification: The monomer exists as a linear chain before any chemical bonding or orientation occurs

phase_3.both_description: The fleeting intermediate where both ends are coordinated but not yet fixed
phase_3.false_description: The bond fails due to insufficient parity alignment
phase_3.true_description: The covalent bond is established at θ > 0.85
phase_3.void_description: The pre-reaction solvent environment containing isolated monomers
